subdomain.name: Treasury & FX
subdomain.capability: Live FX quotes, currency conversion and multi-currency clearing for international routes.
subdomain.why_distinct: Market-rate and treasury position language with its own quote expiry and hedging rules.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Two currencies whose exchange rate is quoted.
Offered rate for a currency pair.
Margin applied over the market rate.
Also Rate Hold Expiry: end of the 30-second quote lock.
Multi-currency balance clearing for international routes.

bounded_contexts.name: FX Settlement
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Issue locked FX quotes, execute conversions and report rate utilization.
invariants: FX quote lock lasts at most 30 seconds
Foreign currency settlement records local amount, foreign amount and exact rate index used
Conversions publish rate utilization metrics to keep treasury hedged

assumptions.item: No FX events are named in the description; quotes are requested synchronously by Payments.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Integration style only; publishes left empty.

assumptions.item: Rate source and hedging process are not described.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: May add a market-data external system or Treasury Position context.
